title: Field Service Levels for PAP Therapy Equipment: Setup, Malfunction Swaps and Loaners
content:
# Field Service Levels — PAP Therapy Equipment

For each PAP Therapy Equipment device class this schedule fixes how many business days after a complete order the initial setup is scheduled, the delivery modes allowed for that setup, whether the setup must be performed by a licensed respiratory therapist, the business days within which a malfunctioning rented device is swapped (or, for a self-pay device, a warranty depot repair is turned around), and whether a loaner device is issued while a patient-owned device is out for repair. Business days run Monday to Friday and exclude Summit Ridge holidays.

| Device class | Setup lead (business days) | Setup modes allowed | Respiratory therapist setup | Swap or depot turnaround (business days) | Loaner during repair of an owned device |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Travel CPAP System (E0601) | 2 | courier, branch setup | no | 5 | no |
| CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) | 3 | in-home setup, branch setup, virtual setup | no | 1 | yes |
| Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) | 3 | in-home setup, branch setup, virtual setup | no | 1 | yes |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) | 3 | in-home setup, branch setup | yes | 1 | yes |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471) | 4 | in-home setup | yes | 1 | yes |
| Adaptive Servo-Ventilation System (E0471) | 5 | in-home setup | yes | 1 | yes |

## Points of reading

- The swap figure of the Travel CPAP System (E0601) is the turnaround of a warranty depot repair, since that class is only ever sold self-pay; for every rented class the figure is the swap of a malfunctioning rented device.
- A virtual setup is offered only on the CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) and the Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601); the two bilevel-timed and servo-ventilation classes are set up only in the home.

**Counting the lead (hypothetical dates).** An order for a Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471) completed on a Monday with no holiday that week is scheduled 4 business days later, on Friday. The same order completed on a Thursday counts Friday, Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, and is scheduled on Wednesday.
